title: Tomato and basil pasta
instructions:
Cook the pasta according to its package instructions.
Warm the oil in a pan and gently cook the garlic for one minute. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Drain the pasta, toss with the sauce and basil, and season to taste.

title: Lemon chickpea salad
ingredients: 400 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions:
Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk the lemon juice and olive oil together, then pour over the salad.
Toss, season to taste, and serve.

title: Ginger vegetable rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice, freshly cooked or safely refrigerated
instructions:
Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the carrot and ginger and stir-fry until the carrot softens.
Add the peas. Push the vegetables aside, add the eggs, and stir until fully cooked.
Add the rice and soy sauce. Stir-fry until everything is steaming hot throughout, then serve immediately.

title: Garlic roasted potatoes
ingredients: 600 g potatoes, cut into small chunks
instructions:
Heat the oven to 220 C (425 F).
Toss the potatoes with the oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer on a baking tray.
Roast for 35 to 45 minutes, turning halfway through, until golden and tender.

title: Tomato and lentil soup
instructions:
Warm the oil in a pot and cook the onion and carrot until softened.
Add the cumin, lentils, tomatoes, and stock. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender. Season to taste.

title: Banana oat pancakes
instructions:
Blend the banana, eggs, oats, and baking powder into a batter. Let it rest for five minutes.
Lightly oil a nonstick pan over medium heat. Spoon in small rounds of batter.
Cook for two to three minutes per side until golden and fully set in the middle. Serve with fresh fruit.
